```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
library(knitr)
if (!requireNamespace("htmltools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  htmlEscape <- function(x) gsub("&", "&amp;", gsub("<", "&lt;", gsub(">", "&gt;", as.character(x), fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)
} else {
  htmlEscape <- htmltools::htmlEscape
}

emit_html <- function(...) {
  knitr::raw_html(paste0(..., collapse = ""))
}

.ccy <- toupper(trimws(as.character(
  if (is.null(params$session_currency) || length(params$session_currency) < 1 ||
      is.na(params$session_currency[[1]])) "USD" else params$session_currency[[1]]
)))
if (!.ccy %in% c("USD", "TWD")) .ccy <- "USD"
.money_px <- if (identical(.ccy, "TWD")) "NT$" else "$"

fmt_price <- function(x) {
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(n) != 1 || is.na(n) || !is.finite(n)) return("N/A")
  paste0(.money_px, format(round(n, 2), nsmall = 2, big.mark = ","))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, signed = TRUE) {
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(n) != 1 || is.na(n) || !is.finite(n)) return("N/A")
  prefix <- if (signed && n > 0) "+" else ""
  paste0(prefix, sprintf("%.1f", n), "%")
}

fmt_ev <- function(x) {
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(n) != 1 || is.na(n) || !is.finite(n)) return("N/A")
  if (abs(n) >= 1e9) paste0(.money_px, round(n / 1e9, 2), "B")
  else if (abs(n) >= 1e6) paste0(.money_px, round(n / 1e6, 2), "M")
  else paste0(.money_px, format(round(n, 0), big.mark = ","))
}

safe_chr <- function(x, default = "N/A") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) return(default)
  s <- trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))
  if (!nzchar(s) || identical(s, "NA")) default else s
}

kable_safe <- function(df) {
  knitr::kable(df, format = "html", escape = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
               table.attr = "class='ynow-table'")
}

.rc <- params$report_copy
if (!is.list(.rc) || is.null(.rc$titles)) {
  .rc <- build_ticker_report_copy(
    locale = safe_chr(params$report_locale, "zh-TW"),
    stock_code = params$stock_code,
    company_name = params$company_name,
    current_price = params$current_price,
    target_price = params$target_price,
    primary_method = params$primary_method,
    method_rationale = params$method_rationale,
    margin_of_safety = params$margin_of_safety,
    upside_pct = params$upside_pct,
    dcf_price = params$dcf_price,
    ddm_value = params$ddm_value,
    pb_value = params$pb_value,
    ri_value = params$ri_value,
    primary_bear = params$primary_bear,
    primary_base = params$primary_base,
    primary_bull = params$primary_bull,
    secondary_point = params$secondary_point,
    confidence_level = params$confidence_level,
    confidence_score = params$confidence_score,
    wacc = params$wacc,
    terminal_growth = params$terminal_growth,
    forecast_years = params$forecast_years,
    dcf_mode = params$dcf_mode,
    eps = params$eps,
    bvps = params$bvps,
    fscore_total = params$fscore_total,
    money_prefix = .money_px
  )
}
.tt <- .rc$titles
```

# `r .tt$section1`

```{r section1-formula, results='asis'}

"<div class='formula-box'><strong>%s</strong><br/>%s<br/>%s</div>",
  htmlEscape(.tt$rating_label),
```

```{r section1-analysis, results='asis'}
paras <- .rc$analysis_paragraphs
if (is.null(paras) || !is.list(paras) || length(paras) < 1L) paras <- list()
if (length(paras) > 0L) {
  parts <- c(sprintf("<div class='analysis-box'><p class='para-title'>%s</p>",
                     htmlEscape(safe_chr(.tt$analysis_heading, "Analysis notes"))))
  for (i in seq_along(paras)) {
    p <- paras[[i]]
    title <- if (is.list(p)) safe_chr(p$title, "") else ""
    body <- if (is.list(p)) safe_chr(p$body, "") else safe_chr(p, "")
    if (!nzchar(body)) next
    lab <- if (nzchar(title)) sprintf("%s. %s", i, title) else as.character(i)
    parts <- c(parts,
      sprintf("<p class='para-title'>%s</p><p class='para-body'>%s</p>",
              htmlEscape(lab), htmlEscape(body)))
  }
  parts <- c(parts, "</div>")
  emit_html(parts)
}
```

```{r section1-bullets, results='asis'}
hl <- .rc$investment_bullets
if (is.null(hl) || length(hl) < 1L) hl <- params$investment_highlights
parts <- c("<div class='highlight-box'><ul style='margin:0; padding-left:18px;'>")
if (!is.null(hl) && length(hl) > 0 && !all(is.na(hl))) {
  for (item in hl) {
    item <- trimws(as.character(item))
    if (nzchar(item)) parts <- c(parts, sprintf("<li style='margin-bottom:4px;'>%s</li>", htmlEscape(item)))
  }
} else {
  parts <- c(parts, sprintf("<li>%s · %s</li>",
      htmlEscape(safe_chr(.rc$mos_formula)),
      htmlEscape(safe_chr(.rc$upside_formula))))
}
parts <- c(parts, "</ul></div>")
emit_html(parts)
```

## `r .tt$fscore`

```{r fscore, results='asis'}
fs_n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$fscore_total)[1])
fq <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$fscore_quality)[1])
if (is.finite(fs_n)) {
  grade <- if (fs_n >= 7) {
    if (identical(safe_chr(params$report_locale), "en")) "Stronger" else "偏強"
  } else if (fs_n >= 4) {
    if (identical(safe_chr(params$report_locale), "en")) "Mixed" else "中等"
  } else {
    if (identical(safe_chr(params$report_locale), "en")) "Weaker" else "偏弱"
  }
  q_txt <- if (is.finite(fq) && fq == 1) {
    if (identical(safe_chr(params$report_locale), "en"))
      "Earnings quality pass (OCF > operating earnings)"
    else "盈餘品質通過（OCF > 營業利益）"
  } else {
    if (identical(safe_chr(params$report_locale), "en"))
      "Earnings quality miss (OCF not above operating earnings)"
    else "盈餘品質未達標（OCF 未高於營業利益）"
  }
  emit_html(sprintf(
"<div class='fscore-box'>
<div class='fscore-score'>F-Score：%d / 9（%s）</div>
<p class='section-lead' style='margin-top:6px; margin-bottom:0;'>%s</p>
</div>",
    as.integer(fs_n), htmlEscape(grade), htmlEscape(q_txt)
  ))
} else {
  emit_html(sprintf(
    "<div class='fscore-box'><p class='section-lead' style='margin:0;'>%s</p></div>",
    htmlEscape(.tt$no_kpi)
  ))
}
cl <- params$fscore_checklist
if (!is.null(cl) && is.data.frame(cl) && nrow(cl) > 0) {
  kable_safe(cl)
}
```

## `r .tt$warnings`

```{r risks, results='asis'}
warn_raw <- params$warnings
warn_items <- character(0)
if (!is.null(warn_raw) && length(warn_raw) > 0 && !all(is.na(warn_raw))) {
  warn_items <- unlist(strsplit(paste(warn_raw, collapse = "\n"), "\n", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE)
  warn_items <- trimws(warn_items)
  warn_items <- warn_items[nzchar(warn_items)]
}
if (length(warn_items) > 0) {
  parts <- c(sprintf("<div class='risk-box-warn'><strong>%s</strong><ul style='margin-top:6px;'>",
                     htmlEscape(.tt$warn_title)))
  for (w in warn_items) parts <- c(parts, sprintf("<li>%s</li>", htmlEscape(w)))
  parts <- c(parts, "</ul></div>")
  emit_html(parts)
} else {
  emit_html(sprintf(
    "<div class='risk-box-ok'><strong>%s</strong> %s</div>",
    htmlEscape(.tt$warnings), htmlEscape(.tt$no_warn)
  ))
}
```

```{r appendix-gate, results='asis'}
    "<p class='section-lead'>%s</p>",
    htmlEscape(safe_chr(.tt$lite_appendix_note,
      if (identical(safe_chr(params$report_locale), "en"))
        "Lite condensed PDF omits statement extracts — open Full mode for the appendix."
      else
        "Lite 精簡版省略財報附錄；完整附錄請改用 Full 模式下載。"
    ))
  ))
} else {
  emit_html("<p class='section-lead'>Ticker financial extracts only (standardized columns; TTM / latest first).</p>")
}
```
